title: Linear sample-processing workflow

intent.message: Samples move through a single linear processing chain from collection to measurement.

claims.statement: Every sample follows the same five-stage processing chain.

expected_design_characteristics: One clear left-to-right reading path with five evenly spaced stages
Equal-role stages share one node shape, size, and stroke language
Orthogonal connectors with no crossings and consistent arrowheads
Stage labels aligned on a shared baseline with reserved connector lanes
known_failure_modes: Stages placed with uneven spacing or drifting baselines
Decorative arrows, shadows, or gradients adding visual noise
Different node shapes used for equal-role processing stages
